mapper.select: SELECT c.code_grp_id AS "groupId",c.code,c.code_nm AS name, (c.use_yn='Y' AND c.del_yn='N' AND g.use_yn='Y' AND length(c.code)<=10) AS active,m.src_text AS source FROM tb_sy_code c JOIN tb_sy_code_grp g ON g.code_grp_id=c.code_grp_id LEFT JOIN tb_sy_code_map m ON m.code_grp_id=c.code_grp_id AND m.code=c.code WHERE c.code_grp_id IN ('CTRT_TYPE','PROJ_STAT') ORDER BY c.code_grp_id,c.code,m.map_id
SELECT proj_id FROM tb_pj_proj ORDER BY proj_id
SELECT clnt_id AS id,btrim(clnt_nm) AS name,replace(biz_reg_no,'-','') AS "businessNo" FROM tb_bs_clnt WHERE use_yn='Y' AND clnt_type_cd IN ('CUST','BOTH') ORDER BY clnt_id
SELECT part_id AS id,btrim(part_nm) AS name,(hq_yn='Y') AS headquarters FROM tb_bs_part WHERE use_yn='Y' ORDER BY part_id

SELECT (SELECT lpad(trunc(std_val)::text,6,'0') FROM tb_sy_oper_std WHERE std_cd='CASH_BASE_YM' ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1) AS "cashBaseMonth", (SELECT trim_scale(std_val)::text FROM tb_sy_oper_std WHERE std_cd='TGT_MRGN_RT' AND aply_bgn_ym <= #{month} ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1) AS "marginRate", (SELECT trim_scale(c.code_val)::text FROM tb_sy_code c JOIN tb_sy_code_grp g ON g.code_grp_id=c.code_grp_id WHERE c.code_grp_id='ALWNC' AND c.code='TEAM_FEE' AND c.use_yn='Y' AND c.del_yn='N' AND g.use_yn='Y') AS "teamExpense", (SELECT trim_scale(c.code_val)::text FROM tb_sy_code c JOIN tb_sy_code_grp g ON g.code_grp_id=c.code_grp_id WHERE c.code_grp_id='ALWNC' AND c.code='PEXP_FEE' AND c.use_yn='Y' AND c.del_yn='N' AND g.use_yn='Y') AS "projectExpense"

SELECT rslt_sn AS sequence,rslt_type_cd AS severity,row_no AS "rowNumber",coalesce(col_nm,'') AS "columnName",coalesce(input_val,'') AS "inputValue",rsn_cn AS reason FROM tb_sy_upld_err WHERE upld_id=#{uploadId} ORDER BY rslt_sn

SELECT upld_id AS "uploadId",form_type_cd AS "formType",scrn_id AS "screenId",file_nm AS filename,file_size AS size, reg_user_id AS actor,upld_stat_cd AS status,tot_row_cnt AS "totalRows",succ_cnt AS "successRows",warn_cnt AS "warningRows",err_cnt AS "errorRows", trgt_proj_id AS "projectId",trgt_dstrb_step_cd AS step,aply_dttm AS "appliedAt" FROM tb_sy_upld WHERE upld_id=#{uploadId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT aft_val FROM tb_sy_chg_hist WHERE trgt_tbl_nm='TB_SY_UPLD' AND trgt_key=CAST(#{uploadId} AS text) AND chg_type_cd='NEW' AND chg_item_nm='검증 문맥' AND chg_rsn='B9' ORDER BY hist_id LIMIT 1
SELECT aft_val AS value,chg_rsn AS reason FROM tb_sy_chg_hist WHERE trgt_tbl_nm='TB_PJ_PROJ' AND chg_type_cd='NEW' AND chg_item_nm='등록' AND starts_with(chg_rsn,#{reasonPrefix}) ORDER BY hist_id
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_sy_upld SET upld_stat_cd='APPLIED',aply_dttm=#{now},mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=#{now} WHERE upld_id=#{uploadId} AND upld_stat_cd='CHECKED'
